title: Generators
description:
Write four generator functions:

```javascript
function* fibonacci() { }            // 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ... forever
function* take(iterable, n) { }      // the first n values of any iterable (stops early, even on infinite ones)
function* chunk(iterable, size) { }  // arrays of `size` values; the last one may be shorter
function* zip(...iterables) { }      // arrays of one value from each, stopping when the shortest ends
```

`take` with `n` of 0 or less gives nothing, and must not ask the iterable for any value at all.
hints: In `take`, check `n` before the loop and return right after the n-th `yield`: a `for...of` that keeps going would ask for one value too many.
For `zip`, get an iterator from each input with `it[Symbol.iterator]()` and call `next()` on all of them in each round.
